description.value:
You've learned to cast powers effectively while mounted. While mounted and not incapacitated, you gain the following benefits.

When you cast a power that targets only yourself, you can extend its effect to your mount as well.

You have advantage on melee force or tech attack rolls against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount.

If your mount would take half damage on a successful Dexterity saving throw against an effect, it instead takes no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure.

system.requirements: 4th level, ability to cast force or tech powers.
